owner_decisions.A: The only comparison and selection reference is HOST DEFAULT versus AC-MOT. Matched static is not a gate, reference, control, objective, or table row. Host default is r1536_n70 with the host's unmodified default confidence handling, exactly as systems 1/2 in scripts/run_baseline_systems.py. Trackers are frozen and identical between systems.
owner_decisions.B: The historical frozen AC-MOT is a detector-side controller. In scripts/run_final_test_3workers_locked.py::FrozenSCIController it interpolates detector confidence and NMS from SCI and selects one of three detector resolutions by threshold_mid/threshold_high. Its StaticBaselineController uses confidence 0.25, NMS 0.45, and size 640. The historical description tracker-threshold-adaptive in PREDECLARATION_BROADENED.json is incorrect for that controller.
owner_decisions.C: The new controller acts only on the original three detector-side knobs: resolution, NMS IoU, and confidence floor. Cue weights and cue computation remain frozen.

historical_terminology_correction.rule: No existing PREDECLARATION* or *_RESULT artifact is edited or deleted.

data_and_evaluation_lock.calibration: research/acmot_paper_v2/DETECTOR_SPLIT.json -> calibration only; 8 sequences in listed order
data_and_evaluation_lock.held_out_val: VisDrone2019-MOT-val is not read, scored, or used for any choice in this search.
data_and_evaluation_lock.objective: CV-mean over the four fixed folds of pooled HOTA(AC-MOT) minus pooled HOTA(host default).

fixed_scene_layer_and_threshold_search.causal_inputs: frame-t image statistics and tracker-reported boxes from frames before t only; never GT
fixed_scene_layer_and_threshold_search.reason_thresholds_are_searched: Commit 293b3c4 diagnosed degenerate historical thresholds: HIGH never occurs on calibration and 7/8 sequences are MEDIUM-dominant.

action_spaces.oatrack_note: OATrack internal min_conf is frozen at 0.40, so lower detector floors have no effect there.
action_spaces.cache_rule: Only existing conf=0.01 caches are filtered by confidence; no detector forward pass is permitted. Existing calibration caches for every listed resolution/NMS point, including 896 and 1728, are reused without regeneration.

confidence_validity_gate.failure_action: Track B is invalid and cannot be selected. Freeze Track A instead and report each failing case and its class ids.

track_a_resolution_nms.stage_1: Optuna GridSampler seed 42 over LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH resolution mapping: 5^3=125 trials; NMS fixed at 0.70.
track_a_resolution_nms.stage_2: Optuna GridSampler seed 42 over LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH NMS mapping: 3^3=27 trials; Stage-1 resolution winner fixed.
track_a_resolution_nms.joint_threshold_action: 60 predeclared Optuna TPE trials, seed 42, jointly searching t_med/t_high and the three-level resolution/NMS mapping seeded from stages 1/2.

track_b_resolution_nms_confidence.stage_1: Same 125-trial resolution grid, with NMS 0.70 and confidence 0.25 fixed.
track_b_resolution_nms_confidence.stage_2: Same 27-trial NMS grid, with the Stage-1 winner fixed and confidence 0.25 fixed.
track_b_resolution_nms_confidence.stage_3a: Optuna GridSampler seed 42 over LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH confidence mapping: 3^3=27 trials, with the preceding winners fixed.
track_b_resolution_nms_confidence.joint_threshold_action: 60 predeclared Optuna TPE trials, seed 42, jointly searching t_med/t_high and all three-level resolution/NMS/confidence actions.

tracks_and_staged_plan.tractability_bound: 426 total candidate evaluations, each on the eight calibration sequences only. The factorization and fixed 60-trial joint budgets are set before results; no trial budget, dataset, evaluator, cue computation, or search space will change after results are seen.

selection_and_freeze_rules.primary: Within each track, select the joint-stage candidate with maximum CV-mean delta HOTA versus host default.
tie_break: fewer distinct three-knob actions across levels
selection_and_freeze_rules.track_choice: If the confidence validity gate passes, freeze Track B. If it fails, freeze Track A; Track A otherwise remains a diagnostic comparator only.
selection_and_freeze_rules.freeze: Write FROZEN_POLICY_DEFAULT_TARGET.json with the selected policy, source result, calibration-only metrics, gate evidence, and the exact git commit hash. No held-out result may modify it.
